runtime: English messages and locale-index are eager; all other messages/<BCP47>.json files are bundled as offline dynamic-import chunks. English is used while the selected chunk loads. whenLocaleReady() rejects failures; the provider displays their technical details. DOM data-locale-ready is true only after the requested catalog is present.
sharedInterface: Rust embeds these same per-locale messages and compact locale metadata. Parsed catalogs and ICU cardinal/decimal formatters are cached; sharing reads current app locale per request, negotiates weighted Accept-Language only for system, emits lang/dir, substitutes plain values once, then escapes the complete HTML text. Sharing has no online translation or script/privileged application bridge.

reviewStatus: Machine output and community attribution do not establish competent language review. Explicit reviewed provenance requires exact locale/source/text-or-forms, application context, translator, separate reviewer, competence and public evidence. No review evidence is inferred from authors or reviewed flags. Fuzzy imports are excluded and reported in excludedCommunity; pinned Android flags and license/source evidence are recorded in community-provenance.json. Incomplete locales remain partial and explicitly fall back to English for missing keys; fully internationalized does not mean fully localized.
